conditions.source_function_docstring:
Exchange-current density for Butler-Volmer reactions between graphite and LiPF6 in
EC:DMC.

References
----------
.. [1] Chang-Hui Chen, Ferran Brosa Planella, Kieran O’Regan, Dominika Gastol, W.
Dhammika Widanage, and Emma Kendrick. "Development of Experimental Techniques for
Parameterization of Multi-scale Lithium-ion Battery Models." Journal of the
Electrochemical Society 167 (2020): 080534.

Parameters
----------
c_e : :class:`pybamm.Symbol`
    Electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]
c_s_surf : :class:`pybamm.Symbol`
    Particle concentration [mol.m-3]
c_s_max : :class:`pybamm.Symbol`
    Maximum particle concentration [mol.m-3]
T : :class:`pybamm.Symbol`
    Temperature [K]

Returns
-------
:class:`pybamm.Symbol`
    Exchange-current density [A.m-2]

parameters.definition: Negative electrode exchange-current density [A.m-2]; literal value or function in the pinned upstream parameter dictionary. Native source units and conventions retained.
limitations: Do not infer A123 18650M1A, AMP20, 26650 m1b or the undisclosed BPX 2 Ah cell from chemistry/capacity; this is a separate nominal parameter set.
Implementation input, not an assertion that this number was measured on this commercial cell. Source defaults, assumptions and borrowed submodels remain distinct from measured characterization.
Optional degradation/mechanics entries require their corresponding model options; including a parameter does not establish cell-specific ageing evidence or a validated model.

AST local substitution only. sech(z)^2 becomes 1-tanh(z)^2 (roundoff may zero negligible tails). Ecker electrolyte conductivity dependency is inlined from the same pinned module. No downloaded source is executed.

representation.domain: Mathematical input domain only: 0<=sto<=1, nonnegative concentrations, c_s_max>0, c_s_surf<=c_s_max, T>0 and L_sei>0 where present. Fit validity must be checked independently.
